payload.claim: The call to `package_phase.reverify` passes no `exempt`, so it defaults to `()` (`saffron/phases/package.py:491`). `exempt` is the set of new test names a post-rebuttal probe confirmed guard a property already true at base, which the `revert` gate must spare even though they are new (`saffron/gates/core/revert.py:131-135`). PACKAGE itself threads `outcome.revert_exempt` into this same call (`saffron/phases/package.py:843`), but that set lives only on the in-cell `outcome` object; no ledger column or fact carries it forward, and `regate.py` has no way to reconstruct it. So for any task whose original PACKAGE run earned a `revert` exemption, `regate` re-judges that same test under `revert` with an empty `exempt`, and the gate can now report it as theater (a `new failure`) even though the identical suite judged the task green at package time. The written acceptance criteria list only `mirror`, `packaged_sha`, `new_base_sha`, `policy`, `gates_dir`, `image` and `spec` for this call, so the diff does what the spec literally asked; this is a gap in what the spec asked for, not a violated criterion, which is why it reads as a concern rather than a blocker.
